logline: One verified fact from the real universe, pushed to its visual extreme in 18 seconds.

auto_replenish.music_style: Awe-driven cosmic underscore with a steady forward pulse; one brief swell at the scale moment; no glacial ambient intro, no gentle outro; end mid-phrase so the loop is seamless.

topic_pool.topic: A day on Venus is longer than its year.
A sugar-cube of neutron star matter would weigh about as much as Mount Everest.
Saturn is less dense than water; given a big enough ocean, it would float.
The Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon and about 400 times farther away: the eclipse coincidence.
TON 618: a black hole weighing tens of billions of Suns, recent estimates near 40 billion.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot, a storm bigger than Earth, has been shrinking for 150 years.
There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
NASA detected pressure waves from a black hole and sonified them: B-flat, 57 octaves below middle C.
On average, Mercury is the closest planet to every other planet.
The light of the galactic center you see tonight left during the last Ice Age.
HD 189733 b: a deep-blue world where winds hit 8,700 km/h and it likely rains molten glass sideways.
What if the Moon vanished tonight? Lunar tides disappear, weaker solar tides remain, and Earth's tilt slowly destabilizes.
The Sun holds about 99.8 percent of all the mass in the Solar System.
A photon can take tens of thousands of years to escape the Sun's core, then just 8 minutes to reach Earth.
Jupiter and the Sun both orbit a shared balance point that lies just outside the Sun's surface.
On WASP-76b, iron vaporizes on the scorching day side and likely condenses into molten-iron rain on the cooler night side.
The International Space Station moves so fast its crew sees about 16 sunrises every day.
Uranus spins on its side, rolling around the Sun like a tipped-over top.
The Moon drifts about 3.8 centimeters farther from Earth every year; total solar eclipses will one day end forever.
A single year on Neptune lasts 165 Earth years; it completed its first full orbit since discovery only in 2011.
New 2025 simulations give the Milky Way and Andromeda only about a coin-flip chance of merging within the next 10 billion years.
Sagittarius A*, the black hole at the center of our galaxy, weighs about 4 million Suns.
On Saturn's moon Titan, methane rains from orange skies and fills rivers and seas, the only other world with standing surface liquid.
Flying a passenger jet to the nearest star would take about 5 million years.
What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning? Everything not bolted down would keep moving at up to 1,670 km/h.
Venus spins backwards, so there the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.
Some of Earth's gold was forged in neutron-star collisions before the Solar System existed; how much is still an open mystery.

auto_replenish.title_style: a sharp English YouTube Shorts title using ONE of these FOUR patterns only, never invent a new one: (1) '<Subject>: <striking epithet>', (2) 'The Universe's <superlative>: <X>', (3) '<Subject>: <impossible fact stated flat>', (4) 'What If <X>? <consequence>' only for the what-if family, with at most one ALL-CAPS word. No emoji, no hashtags, no surrounding quotes.

DEĞİŞMEZ KURALLAR: (1) İMZA FORMAT: Üç çekim vardır. shot 1 ŞOK: gerçek gök cismi en dramatik halinde, iddia narration ilk cümlesinde; yavaş yıldız alanı, logo ve welcome kurulumu yasak. shot 2 ÖLÇEK: karşılaştırma veya yakınlaşma faktın ölçeğini hissettirir. shot 3 UÇURUM: uç sonuç, kompozisyon shot 1'e rimlenir ve hareket sürerken biter. (2) AİLE ROTASYONU: family her partta zorunludur ve yalnız şu kanonik değerlerden biri olur: güneş sistemi uçları, kozmik kader, derin uzay canavarları, cehennem gezegenler, ölçek şoku, bilim temelli what-if. Aynı aile üst üste iki bölümde kullanılamaz. (3) DOĞRULUK: Fakt gerçek astronomi veya astrofizikten gelir ve yaygın kaynakla doğrulanabilir; sayı uydurulamaz. Konu yalnız runtime enjekte edilen topic_pool girdilerinden seçilir; her partta tam sayı seed_id zorunludur ve yalnız o tohumun konusu ile family değeri kullanılır. Tohum listesi bu brief'te yer almaz. (4) YORUM YEMİ: Bölüm başına en fazla bir yarım-soru; dini veya komplocu kışkırtma ve rage-bait yasak. (5) SES: Narration 30-44 kelimedir; ilk cümle iddianın kendisidir. Selamlama, CTA ve 'did you know' yasak. (6) LOOP DİKİŞİ: Son kompozisyon ilk kareye döner; kapanış kartı, sunum jesti ve kutlama yasak. (7) GÜVENLİK: Korku estetiği ve epilepsi riski yaratan hızlı flaş dizileri yok; ton dehşet değil huşudur. (8) MÜZİK: Huşu odaklı kozmik altlık sabit ileri nabız taşır, ölçek anında tek kısa kabarma yapar ve kesintisiz loop için cümlenin ortasında biter.
